block_witness.statement: all 6 ordered completions are present and equally weighted

fence: NONADMISSION carries the explicit sentinel (target_index=-1, target_symbol='BOTTOM'). Bottom is NOT encoded as FFF=000, NOT as pp=00, NOT as Event index 0, and NOT as any algebraic zero. Event index 0 is a genuine certified Event and is never overloaded as bottom.
bottom_fence.statement: bottom is the explicit sentinel (-1, 'BOTTOM'); it is not FFF=000, not pp=00, not Event index 0, and not any algebraic zero

catalogue.order_source: topographo.ssd.fips_adapter.EventIndex.build() == fips_basic.EVENTS (CI-pinned, N_EVENTS = 84); blocks ordered by the stable textual block key, never by set/dict iteration order or hash()

census.prediction_policy: counts were predicted from the certified structure before the dataset was built; a mismatch is reported, never absorbed into the prediction

determinism.interpreter_state_excluded: no interpreter flag (including PYTHONHASHSEED / sys.flags.hash_randomization) is recorded, so the artifact is byte-identical across hash seeds
determinism.statement: every ordering in this module comes from integer indices, sorted textual ray/block keys, or explicit tuples; no set/dict iteration order and no hash() value reaches the artifact

consumers: fold construction: leave-one-Fano-point-out over 7 points, both signs
provided: habitat and Fano-point membership lists for fold construction
per-class position lists over the 7056-record pool

fences: Labels come from the certified native FIPS relation (fips_basic), never from the SFP circuit under test.
FFF=000 and pp=00 are formal completion values only, not Events and not bottom.
SFP is a representation layer, not a replacement OT evaluator.
No per-Event free output identity: downstream scoring must be relational.

label_rule.correctness_criterion: exact certified Event identity via topographo.ssd.projective.equivalent; never float proximity, never a soft ranking
label_rule.source: topographo.ssd.fips_basic.admissible / topographo.ssd.fips_basic.third — the certified native FIPS relation. sfp.ExactSfpCircuit is NEVER consulted for a label: label generation (label_pair / build_dataset) accepts no circuit argument, and sfp is imported only inside sfp_cross_check, which runs after the dataset is frozen and may only read it.
label_rule.statement: ADMIT with target = unique third Event iff a != b and a, b share exactly one certified cyclic block; otherwise NONADMISSION (bottom)
structural_enforcement: label_pair(catalogue, a_index, b_index) takes no circuit argument
sfp is imported only inside sfp_cross_check, after freezing
sfp_cross_check returns a diagnostic and never a label

native_consistency.correctness_criterion: exact certified Event identity via topographo.ssd.projective.equivalent; never float proximity, never a soft ranking
native_consistency.label_source: topographo.ssd.fips_basic.admissible / topographo.ssd.fips_basic.third — the certified native FIPS relation. sfp.ExactSfpCircuit is NEVER consulted for a label: label generation (label_pair / build_dataset) accepts no circuit argument, and sfp is imported only inside sfp_cross_check, which runs after the dataset is frozen and may only read it.
native_consistency.statement: native admissible(a, b) coincides with 'distinct and sharing exactly one certified cyclic block' on all 7056 ordered pairs

purpose: the frozen admit-and-force dataset: all 7056 ordered Event pairs labelled ADMIT / NONADMISSION from the certified native FIPS relation
record_layout: row-major: the record for (a, b) sits at position a * 84 + b; Dataset.record(a, b) and Dataset.target(a, b) look it up

reference_oracle_diagnostic.role: reference-oracle diagnostic; NOT the label source

role_neutrality.statement: no privileged direction and no separate structure for one completion: all 56 * 6 = 336 ordered completions are ordinary records in one pool
